name: Factor common Boolean subexpression
template: Extract a shared Boolean subexpression that is currently recomputed along a long chain, so logic depth on the critical cone drops. Pure factoring; the computed function is identical.

example.before: assign y = (a & b & c) | (a & b & d);
example.after: wire ab = a & b; assign y = (ab & c) | (ab & d);

guardrails: Factoring must preserve the exact Boolean function for all inputs.
Do not introduce registers or change latency.
Do not touch the module ports or the clocked always block.
